headline: Track projects, invoices, and revisions effortlessly
value_proposition: A bilingual (Arabic and English) digital template pack built for local freelancing habits, with no subscriptions and no collection of client data
features: Track client projects with organized templates
Manage invoices sent and revision rounds in one place
Built for local freelancing habits in Arabic and English
No subscriptions or client data collection
Simple and ready to use with Notion and Google Sheets

faq.q: What is included in the template pack?
faq.a: The template pack includes Notion and Google Sheets templates for tracking client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.

faq.q: Can I use the templates in Arabic and English?
faq.a: Yes, the templates are bilingual and support both Arabic and English.

faq.q: What file formats are the templates available in?
faq.a: The templates are available in Notion and Google Sheets formats for easy use.

faq.q: Does the product help with invoicing?
faq.a: The templates help manage invoices sent and track revision rounds, but they do not generate invoices automatically.

faq.q: Can I use the templates for multiple clients?
faq.a: Yes, the templates are designed to help manage multiple clients efficiently.

claims.claim: Notion Freelance Templates are free and designed for independent professionals, offering project proposals, client management tools, invoice trackers, and time management sheets.
claims.quote: Empower your freelance journey with Notion's Freelance templates. Designed for independent professionals, our collection includes project proposals, client management tools, invoice trackers, and time management sheets.

claims.claim: Fontiverse provides free Google Sheets templates for freelance designers, covering client management, project scheduling, invoicing, and financial tracking.
claims.quote: The best Google Sheets templates for freelance designers help manage clients, deadlines, deliverables, invoices, and business finances in one familiar platform.
